name: Galaxea Dynamics
summary:
Galaxea Dynamics develops embodied AI foundation models and robot platforms as a combined hardware-and-intelligence system. Founded in September 2023, the company serves technology companies, startups, universities and research laboratories working on manipulation, autonomy and physical-world learning.

Its customer work covers algorithm development, data collection and application deployment. The company draws on experience in bringing complex technology products and autonomous-driving systems into production, applying that background to robot development. Its stated approach emphasizes collaboration with the embodied AI community so that researchers and industry teams can use shared platforms to develop and test capabilities in real operating environments.
